title: NoSpreaditem
description: Collects all dropped items from a dead player into a single block instead of scattering
body:
NoSpreadItem Description


<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/kQmKVkaiK1I" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

NoSpreadItem is a lightweight plugin that prevents items from scattering when a player dies.
Instead of dropping in random directions, all items stay neatly stacked in one spot. This makes it easier to collect items, reduces clutter, and helps improve server performance.
